audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers agree with each other but three rows contradict their own reasons. Row 0 says Neeko while whys[0] says 'he's a tank who eats poke and farms through it'. Row 2 says Ornn while whys[2] and spikes[0] both call Level 3 'your one clean poke window'. Row 3 says Ornn while whys[3] says 'trades stay even'. The packet chart (Skill / Skill / Neeko / Skill / Neeko / Ornn / Ornn) matches the reasons on all seven rows.
audit.why: Ornn is immobile before his ult, so Tangle-Barbs is the one root in Neeko's matchup pool that reliably connects — Level 3 genuinely is hers. Level 1 is not: she has one single-target spell against a tank. Also the header was internally inconsistent: diff 'HARD' sat next to a green tone, diffRating 4/10, and 'Favoured matchup' in two places, against a 42.86% win rate and a page whose own late section says the lane is lost.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2 and 3 flipped to Skill / Neeko / Skill as matched full+content pairs with ratings; tone to orange, diffRating 4/10 -> 6.5/10, carryRating 5/10 -> 6.5/10, and both 'Favoured matchup' lines rewritten to Hard.

audit.why: Four spikes with the right timings: her Level 3 root window, her Level 6 Pop Blossom, his first item off Living Forge, and his late R. Living Forge funding items without a recall is genuinely the reason his power curve outruns hers, and the page already says so.
audit.corrected: Timings kept; the ability mechanics inside spikes[1].text corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1] all credit the interrupt on Pop Blossom to 'his W Brittle' or 'Brittle CC'. Brittle is a debuff applied by Bellows Breath's final gout and by his ult; it is not itself an interrupt. The thing that actually knocks Neeko out of the wind-up is Searing Charge — and Searing Charge only produces a knockup when Ornn collides with terrain, which is why Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar exists. The Q-pillar-into-E combo is the single defining interaction of this matchup and the page never states it. (b) early credits Brittle to 'his passive on a return hit' — Living Forge is bonus resists plus item forging and has nothing to do with Brittle. (c) tradeBad and dontsFull[1].d are boilerplate about 'a mobile champion' and 'whiffing it into a dash', while the page's own early paragraph correctly says Ornn has no dash.
audit.why: A player told to fear a debuff will hide from the wrong spell and stand next to a wall — which is exactly where Searing Charge is lethal. Told the right rule, they simply ult in open ground away from his fresh pillar and the interrupt never happens.
audit.corrected: Searing Charge (450 range, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s) knocks up only on terrain collision. Volcanic Rupture (800 range, 9s at rank 1) plants a magma pillar to supply that terrain. Stay off walls and off his pillar and the knockup has nothing to hit. Brittle comes from Bellows Breath's final gout and from Call of the Forge God.
